topography.project_purpose: DODO is a decentralized exchange protocol and on-chain liquidity provider that uses a proactive market maker (PMM) algorithm to support efficient trading and liquidity provisioning across multiple chains, with AMM pool factories and routing/aggregation products.
topography.relationship_narrative: The DODO family provides the foundational AMM factories and token, while DODO Agg builds on top with vaults and staking contracts that interact with DODO pools and external liquidity sources. DODO AMM is a parallel set of factory deployments sharing the same PMM design, often on separate chains, and may be used by aggregation services.
